session_secret: APPFACTORY_SESSION_SECRET must be stable across restarts and deployments
durability_declaration: APPFACTORY_AUTH_STORAGE_DURABLE=true only after the persistent path is mounted and verified
completion_gate: A successful live login on ephemeral storage is test evidence, not production-ready membership evidence

render_default.architecture: paid Render web service plus minimum persistent disk plus SQLite
render_default.why: Reuse the proven simple single-instance pattern before introducing managed PostgreSQL complexity.
render_default.scale_up_rule: Monitor capacity and increase disk only when evidence requires it; Render disks cannot be reduced afterward.

pre_purchase_automatic_work: generate the disk mount and SQLite path contract
prepare APPFACTORY_SESSION_SECRET, APPFACTORY_ADMIN_EMAILS, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and APPFACTORY_AUTH_DB_PATH variable names
prepare a safe SQLite copy and integrity-check plan
single_paid_owner_action: confirm the Render paid service and persistent-disk purchase in the provider checkout
post_purchase_automatic_work: set APPFACTORY_AUTH_STORAGE_DURABLE=true only after the mount is verified
migrate existing SQLite membership data without overwriting a newer durable database
deploy, log in, deploy again, and verify the same user_id and owner_admin membership remain
postgresql_policy: PostgreSQL is optional for multi-instance concurrency or operational scale; it is not required for the initial Stage 3 Google login launch.
